font.$description: Raw typographic values. Components use the composed styles under type.

sans.$description: The default typeface for interface text. Covers Vietnamese fully.

mono.$description: The typeface for code and tabular figures.

medium.$description: Medium weight, for labels and emphasis.

size.$description: Font sizes in rem, named after their size in pixels at the default root size.

12.$description: 12px equivalent: the smallest size, for captions only.

14.$description: 14px equivalent: secondary text and small labels.

16.$description: 16px equivalent: the base size for body text.

18.$description: 18px equivalent: large labels and lead text.

24.$description: 24px equivalent: headings. Counts as large text for contrast.

line-height.$description: Line heights as multiples of the font size.

snug.$description: For single-line labels. The lowest value that clears stacked Vietnamese diacritics.

normal.$description: For body text in any supported script.

none.$description: No extra tracking. The default for every text style.
